title: Projects
description: Products you recognise, and the environments running for them on this host.
catalogDescription: A Project is the product. An Environment is one Compose stack running for it on this host.
needsDatabaseHint: They are decisions rather than observations, so they are persisted. Start PostgreSQL and the catalog comes back; environments still list without it.
catalogEmptyHint: Create a product, then attach repositories and adopt the environments running for it.

create.title: New project
create.description: A name and a slug. Repositories and environments are attached afterwards.
create.name: Name
create.slugHint: Also what an environment's portta.project label must say to be adopted automatically.

emptyHint: An environment appears when Compose is up on this host. Adopt it onto a Project with the portta.project label or by hand.

actions.startDisabled: Every service is already running, or the containers are gone.
actions.stopConfirm: {{name}} has {{count}} service(s). Nothing is removed; Start brings them back.

operations.rebuildDisabled: This project has no Compose working directory, so the runner cannot rebuild it.
operations.rebuildDescription: {{name}} will be rebuilt with docker compose up --build. Named volumes stay.
operations.noCacheCost: Ignores the build cache; this will take considerably longer.
operations.rebuildFailed: Rebuild failed. The log is below.
operations.removeDataTitle: Remove this project and local data?
operations.githubUntouched: The GitHub repository, its issues, its branches and its pull requests are not touched.
operations.previewVolumes: Named volumes: {{names}}. Size is unknown: the panel cannot inspect volumes.
operations.alsoDirectory: Also remove the working directory on this host.
operations.directoryNeedsRunner: Directory removal needs the runner. Without it the panel prints the exact rm -rf for you.
operations.dirtyOverride: The working tree is dirty ({{staged}} staged, {{unstaged}} unstaged, {{untracked}} untracked). Override and remove the directory anyway.
